name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio with software, API integration, automation and electronics projects. English and Polish versions.
readme: Personal portfolio for Piotr Jeleniewicz, an electronics and telecommunications student and software developer based in Gdynia, Poland.

name: TurfMatchMaking
description: Configurable Krunker lobby finder with live validation and server hunting
readme: A HIGHLY configurable Krunker game finder userscript.Pick your rules once, press one key, and you are set.
summary_en: A Krunker lobby finder. You set your rules once, press one key and it finds a matching server.
summary_pl: Wyszukiwarka lobby w Krunkerze. Raz ustawiasz zasady, naciskasz jeden klawisz i skrypt znajduje pasujący serwer.

name: Xcape53
description: Profile README for Piotr Jeleniewicz - software development, API integration and automation.
readme: I develop Python and JavaScript applications, integrate services through APIs and build automation tools. I am interested in system design and software that connects with devices.

name: SeeSky-tracking
description: Radio telescope software with a Python REST API, an Express dashboard and an interactive sky map.
readme: SeeSky Tracking is a control and observation interface for an amateur radio telescope on an altitude-azimuth mount. It combines astronomical coordinate calculations, a REST API, an observation queue, and a browser-based control panel.
summary_en: Control and observation software for an amateur radio telescope on an alt-az mount, with a Python REST API and an Express dashboard.
summary_pl: Oprogramowanie do sterowania amatorskim radioteleskopem na montażu azymutalnym i do obserwacji, z REST API w Pythonie i panelem w Expressie.

name: Yapper
description: Windows speech-to-text app with two push-to-talk channels and online or offline transcription engines.
readme: Yapper is a Windows speech-to-text application with two independent push-to-talk channels. Each channel has its own microphone, shortcut, and transcription language. The recognition engine is selected for the whole application.
summary_en: Windows dictation with two push-to-talk channels, each with its own microphone, shortcut and language.
summary_pl: Dyktowanie w Windowsie z dwoma kanałami push-to-talk. Każdy ma własny mikrofon, skrót i język.

name: LabInc
description: Java incremental game about building and upgrading a chemical production network.
readme: LabInc is a Java incremental game about building a chemical production network. The player starts with basic extraction, reinvests revenue in upgrades, and unlocks increasingly advanced factories and elements.
summary_en: A Java incremental game about building and upgrading a chemical production network.
summary_pl: Gra inkrementalna w Javie, w której budujesz i rozbudowujesz sieć produkcji chemicznej.
